page.title: Pick a table. *Play.*
page.lede: The games shipped on Rusty Buns, and a draft of the cube where QNTBR started.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.text: Every table is a *Durable Object* at the edge. Actions go over a WebSocket, the room applies them, and everyone at the table sees the same board at the same time. Accounts are moving to *eqosys*, one login for every Q app.

rustybuns.title: Built with Rusty Buns
rustybuns.lede: Games shipped on Rusty Buns, each running on its own Worker.

mtg.title: Magic: The Gathering
mtg.lede: Where QNTBR started: one link to draft the cube.

draft.tagline: Booster draft from the vintage cube
draft.description: Open a draft room on the cube, share the link, and pick packs together in real time. The deck you draft saves straight to your list.

park-hide-seek.description: 3D hide and seek on real Yosemite terrain. Each player is sent only what they can see.
park-hide-seek.pitch1: Drop in from the sky onto real Yosemite terrain, pick a boulder, and disappear.
park-hide-seek.pitch2: The server only sends you what you can actually see, so there is no wall peek and no map cheat. Just the woods, and whoever is in them.
park-hide-seek.pitch3: Find everyone before the clock runs out, or be the last one nobody found.

skate-tech-park.tagline: A giant skateboard shredding America’s National Parks
skate-tech-park.description: A giant riderless fingerboard on park terrain, up to four riders.
skate-tech-park.pitch1: A skateboard the size of a school bus, no rider, and a National Park for a skatepark.
skate-tech-park.pitch2: Grind the granite, launch off the ridgeline, and bring three friends: four boards to a session.
skate-tech-park.pitch3: It makes no sense at all. Shred it anyway.

git-recon.tagline: Git the main HEAD merged before the Conflict takes over
git-recon.description: A toy-soldier shooter fought in a codebase: folders become compounds and files become buildings.
git-recon.pitch1: Your repo is the map. Folders are compounds, files are buildings, and the Conflict is spreading through main.
git-recon.pitch2: Drop in as a toy soldier, fight your way up the tree, and get HEAD merged before the whole branch goes red.
git-recon.pitch3: Point it at any codebase. Yours plays nothing like anyone else’s.

two-fronts.description: Turn-based strategy on a forest moon, with three.js battles on the ground and in orbit.

druids-curse.tagline: The game Rusty Buns was built for
druids-curse.description: The live multiplayer game Rusty Buns was first built for.

splat-spray.description: Scan a Gaussian-splat room and find 100 things in the fewest shots.

excalibrawl.description: An hourly drawing fight between two models, refereed by a third.

alien-disc-golf.tagline: Nine holes on a real-wind globe
alien-disc-golf.description: Nine holes between countries on a 3D globe, the disc carried by NOAA's real wind right now; loft it into the jet stream if you dare.

hippo-tycoon.description: Four greedy oil-baron hippos race to chomp the most oil from a jungle geyser; solo, couch, LAN or online.

mythic-masters.description: A 3D arena brawler of 76 folklore beasts where mass and height are real, from a 6 kg jackalope to a tonne of lake monster.

delayed-reaction.tagline: Answer the note a bar later
delayed-reaction.description: A phone-first dub rhythm game: a ring calls a note down a neon tunnel and you answer it a bar later.

splat-rooms.tagline: Find everything in a real, scanned room
splat-rooms.description: The room goes dark and you get a list. Find every object in a photoreal Gaussian-splat room.
splat-rooms.pitch1: A real room, scanned to the last sock, and the lights just went out.
splat-rooms.pitch2: You get a list. Every object in the room has a label and a box, and you have to find them all.
splat-rooms.pitch3: Quick hunt drops you somewhere random. Good luck.

what-would-fantano-say.tagline: A parody review of your best 15 seconds
what-would-fantano-say.description: Pick a track, drag to your best 15 seconds and get a parody review with a score. A joke, labelled as one.
what-would-fantano-say.pitch1: Pick a track and drag to the 15 seconds you are proudest of.
what-would-fantano-say.pitch2: Get a score, a verdict, the best and worst bits, and a share button. It is parody, and it says so.
